correctness.rationale: For nonzero linearly independent g1,g2 let a,b>0, rho∈(−1,1), H=GᵀG. Source Aligned-MTL has uniform d=(sigma_min(G)/2)G H^(−1/2)1, so (g1·d,g2·d)=(sigma_min(G)/2)H^(1/2)1. The exact positive-definite 2×2 square root is (H+ab sqrt(1−rho²)I)/sqrt(tr H+2ab sqrt(1−rho²)). Its two component signs are those of a+b(rho+sqrt(1−rho²)) and b+a(rho+sqrt(1−rho²)). When rho≥−1/sqrt2 both are positive; otherwise tau=−rho−sqrt(1−rho²)∈(0,1), and both positive iff tau<a/b<1/tau, with exact neutrality/harm at boundaries. For a=b,rho≤0 the all-ones Gram eigenvector belongs to sigma_min, so d=(g1+g2)/2; when rho>0 the scalar is sqrt((1−rho)/(1+rho)). Independently evaluated exact rho=−4/5, tau=1/5 and q=1/10,1/5,1,5,10 to confirm full sign transitions; source eigenvalue verifier inspected. This is instantaneous original-task first-order descent only, not whole optimization convergence.
